assessments.reasoning: The nine contiguous parts cover 132,314 bytes of the pinned SPDX json/details/GPL-3.0-or-later.json. Part 1 sets isDeprecatedLicenseId to false. Part 5 gives licenseId GPL-3.0-or-later, the name “GNU General Public License v3.0 or later,” the express optional election and comments tying it to the file notice. Its seeAlso cites GNU's gpl-3.0-standalone.html and OSI's /license/GPL-3.0. The OSI URL spelling does not alter the exact licenseId.

The v3.29.0 tag's target commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48 matches the revision in the claim and in the or-later record's URL. The tag is unsigned and establishes release provenance only. The record at the target supplies the identifier and election.

In the GNU publisher capture, §14 in part 2 gives the recipient the numbered-or-later choice when the program specifies it. The application notice in part 3 names version 3 and says “or (at your option) any later version.” This directly supports the meaning of the election and explains why a real file's notice matters.

limitations: The finding applies to a notice that actually offers that choice. The project's notice establishes which code it covers and any modifications. The proposed Index state adds no licensing permission.

The two identifiers describe different grants using the same publisher edition. The release and data commit qualify SPDX membership. The FSF authority in the scope qualifies the base instrument. Neither record establishes an exception or its application to a project.
reasoning: SPDX License List 3.29.0 lists GPL-3.0-or-later for the election expressed as “either version 3 of the License, or (at your option) any later version.” Section 14 identifies the eligible later versions as GNU GPL versions published by the Free Software Foundation. The claim's “recipient's option” accurately paraphrases “your option.”
